site_key_file.description: Filename of the Tripwire site key (must match actual filename in /etc/tripwire/).

policy_file.description: Filename of the Tripwire policy configuration file.

site_key_encryption_file.description: Filename containing the encrypted site key used for signing configuration files.

local_key_encryption_file.description: Filename containing the encrypted local host key used for signing databases/reports.

db_name.description: Name of the Tripwire database file stored in /var/lib/tripwire/.

email_report_level.description: Level of detail in email reports (0–4). Higher values include more diagnostic info.

syslogging_enabled.description: If true, send Tripwire alerts to the system log (syslog).

syslog_level.description: Syslog facility and priority for Tripwire messages (e.g., local0.warning).

security_level.description: Security level (0–100). Higher = stricter enforcement (e.g., prevents config changes without site passphrase).

email_body_include.description: If true, include the full report body in the email message (not just summary).

email_summary_include.description: If true, include the report summary line in the email subject or body.

email_recipients.description: List of e-mail addresses to notify when integrity violations are detected.

database_lock_enabled.description: If true, lock the database file after writing to prevent unauthorized modification.

sign_reports_enabled.description: If true, digitally sign generated reports with GPG to ensure integrity and authenticity.

gpg_local_key.description: GPG key ID (or local user name) used for signing reports. Leave empty to use default.

compress_reports_enabled.description: If true, compress archived reports (e.g., .gz) to save disk space.

database_upgrade_mode.description: Set to true only when upgrading the database schema (e.g., during major version changes).
